assumptions: The exception for directions by a police officer or traffic control signal is left out of the rule because that behaviour cannot be determined from the vehicle track alone; the rule is applied as though no contrary direction applies.

Anchor is 'center' because the boxes are vehicles viewed from above and their centre is stated to be their metric position, while 'bottom_center' is the downstream AABB edge rather than wheels or ground contact.
A stop is operationalised as a continuous DWELL in stop_zone for at least 1000 ms with max_speed 0.05 (still); the statute gives no minimum stop duration or numeric speed threshold.
Stopping anywhere continuously within stop_zone, the last 10 metres before the stop line, counts as stopping at the near side at the marked stop line.
BEFORE has within_ms null (no maximum interval) because the statute gives no time limit between stopping and subsequently crossing.
The inbound crossing direction is +y across stop_line, which the line description maps to 'to_right'.
Each tracked vehicle is checked independently; a vehicle that never crosses stop_line inbound passes under the IMPLIES idiom.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: A vehicle crossing the marked stop line inbound must first have stopped still in the approach waiting zone before the line.

provenance.reason: Tracked objects are vehicles; the statute addresses the driver of a vehicle, and drivers are not separately tracked.
Statute does not specify a measured point; line/zone description states top-down vehicle boxes' centre is metric position and bottom_center is downstream AABB edge, not wheels.

provenance.quote: at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line

provenance.reason: Statute requires a stop but states no minimum duration; 1000 ms operationalises a sustained complete stop.
Statute says the driver shall stop but gives no numeric speed; 0.05 is the provided DSL threshold for stopped/still.
Statute does not name a DSL direction; inbound approach is +y per the line description, and moving downwards (+y) across stop_line is mapped to to_right.

text: Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal, the driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection shall stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line.
